ravenrs_pdf/third_party/lopdf/
cmap_section.rs

1/*
2ToUnicode CMaps are special CMaps and thus can be parsed simpler. Assumptions:
3- /CMapType is always 2
4- only bfchar and bfrange sections allowed
5- no glyph names as target allowed, only hex strings
6- target encoded in UTF16-BE
7 */
8
9pub(crate) type ArrayOfTargetStrings = Vec<Vec<u16>>;
10
11// According to pdf documentation source codes can be of various byte length but they
12// should be smaller than integer
13pub(crate) type SourceCode = u32;
14pub(crate) type CodeLen = u8;
15pub(crate) type SourceRangeMapping = ((SourceCode, SourceCode, CodeLen), ArrayOfTargetStrings);
16pub(crate) type SourceCharMapping = ((SourceCode, CodeLen), Vec<u16>);
17#[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
18pub enum CMapSection {
19    CsRange(Vec<(SourceCode, SourceCode, CodeLen)>),
20    BfChar(Vec<SourceCharMapping>),
21    BfRange(Vec<SourceRangeMapping>),
22}
23
24#[derive(Debug)]
25pub enum CMapParseError {
26    Incomplete,
27    Error,
28}
